title: Selected energy at every positive gap
description: Proves Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and character when Re(s) > 8733819666133/10000000000000, excluding only the principal pole. A reserve-parametric fourth-power seed and a selected-energy adapter for every fixed positive gap above one half supply two finite source lines and a complete five-window return. The final theorem has no analytic or source-provider premise. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, Sil and Jacob Sussman, including the PR93 selected sextic norm and PR97 selected-leaf energy. Inherited notices and licenses are retained. The development was AI-assisted.
